marketingText: Spectrum GNP560-WT Wheeled Trimmer The Spectrum GNP560-WT Wheeled Trimmer is a powerful, easy-to-use solution for clearing dense grass, nettles, and thick undergrowth over large and uneven landscapes. Designed to combine strength with practicality, it's ideal for tackling tough vegetation across challenging terrain. Key Features: 166cc Four-Stroke Air-Cooled Engine: Provides efficient fuel use and low emissions, delivering consistent performance with reduced environmental impact. OHV (Overhead Valve) Design: Helps the engine run cooler and more efficiently, contributing to improved durability and longer lifespan. Tough Cutting Performance: Equipped with a robust 4mm cutting line that can easily manage heavy, overgrown vegetation. Customisable Cutting Height: Adjustable between 30mm and 90mm to suit different ground conditions and cutting requirements. Generous 56cm Cutting Width: Covers a wide area in less time, making it far more efficient than standard handheld alternatives. Smooth Mobility: Large 355mm spoked wheels and a push-forward design allow for stable and effortless movement over bumpy or sloped ground. User-Friendly Build: Padded handles help reduce strain during extended use, and the foldable design ensures easy storage when not in use. Whether you're managing a large property or handling professional landscaping tasks, the Spectrum GNP560-WT offers the performance and reliability needed to get the job done with minimal hassle.
